Technical innovations are integrated into the aerodynamic design to elevate both the drive and interior experience.

  • The front aero wing attaches the air to the hood, increasing aerodynamic efficiency and extending range.

  • The full-length panoramic roof lets more light into the cabin, creating a feeling of airy spaciousness.

  • The interior provides plenty of room, with a comfortable distance between seat rows and a completely flat floor.

  • The rear aero wing adds to the handling and energy efficiency of Polestar 3 by increasing downforce and reducing turbulence.

The front aero wing attaches the air to the hood, increasing aerodynamic efficiency and extending range.

The full-length panoramic roof lets more light into the cabin, creating a feeling of airy spaciousness.

The interior provides plenty of room, with a comfortable distance between seat rows and a completely flat floor.

The rear aero wing adds to the handling and energy efficiency of Polestar 3 by increasing downforce and reducing turbulence.

Placing the seat rows further apart provides generous legroom. The minimalist design and carefully curated interior themes emphasize the spaciousness of the cabin.

Interior features

  • Pairing expertly crafted details with responsibly sourced materials, the upholstery represents a new form of luxury.

    Interior features

The active air suspension⁴ uses multiple sensors to detect car, road, and driver input 500 times a second, smoothing out even the bumpiest road surfaces.

The bespoke Bowers & Wilkins audio system integrates Dolby Atmos, active road noise cancellation, and Abbey Road Studios Mode for an unparalleled in-car listening experience.

Included with every Polestar 3

  • Polestar includes comprehensive warranties with every Polestar car:

    • Vehicle warranty: covers any parts that fail due to manufacturing defects with free repairs or replacements at an authorized Polestar service point. This warranty covers the first four years after delivery, or 50,000 miles, whichever comes first. It is valid regardless of a change in ownership.
    • Battery warranty: covers any faults in battery performance or defects in material and workmanship will be resolved free of charge, within 8 years or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. If the battery’s State-of-Health drops below 70% of its original capacity within the first 8 years of ownership or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first, the battery will be repaired or replaced at no cost.
    • Corrosion warranty: covers the repair or replacement of affected panel(s) perforated by corrosion at an authorized Polestar service point, free of charge. Coverage lasts for the first 12 years after delivery, regardless of a change in ownership, with possible regional variations.
    Read more about warranty

  • Every new Polestar comes with 4 years of free roadside assistance. Pressing the connect button in the overhead console will guarantee 24/7 support, including car recovery.

    Scheduled maintenance is complimentary for the first 3 years after delivery, or 30,000 miles, whichever comes first, for new 2025 Polestar 3 vehicles. Service includes exterior cleaning, pickup, and delivery arranged around the driver's schedule.⁶

  • Regular over-the-air updates are included, enhancing the car's features and systems without the need to visit a workshop. Secure internet access with a 3-year data plan is also included, enabling web browsing, app use, music streaming, and real-time traffic updates.

  • Polestar drivers have access to a growing number of public charging stations compatible with the Combined Charging System (CCS) and the North American Charging Standard (NACS). NACS adapters are available for purchase from a Polestar Service Point.
